summary: Ran svelte-autofixer and Prettier on the new workspace configuration components, then verified the refactor with svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings) and the full app test suite (28 files, 165 tests passed). The refactor reduced WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte to 135 LOC and extracted cohesive subcomponents under workspace/configure/.
decisions: Refactor preserves the public import path and props API of WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte while moving subcomponent logic into workspace/configure/.
Targeted Prettier write/check is run on the refactored files rather than the whole tree to avoid touching concurrent unrelated changes.
No tests were added or modified because the existing App.test.ts suite already covers the workspace configuration interactions (e.g., 'Unity enabled here' switch).
